quick_skim.title: Gradient-extrapolation-based distributed mirror descent algorithm for multi-cluster aggregative games
quick_skim.abstract: This paper studies a class of multi-cluster aggregative games characterized by the coexistence of cooperation and competition, where each agent's cost function depends on its own strategy and the aggregate of all agents' strategies. To address the Nash equilibrium seeking problem for such games in the non-Euclidean setting, a distributed mirror descent algorithm with gradient extrapolation is proposed over time-varying intra-cluster and inter-cluster networks. The mirror descent framework employs a general Bregman divergence as the distance measure, providing greater flexibility than Euclidean-based methods, while gradient extrapolation exploits historical gradient information to improve convergence performance. Under the restricted strong monotonicity characterized by the Bregman divergence, the convergence of the proposed algorithm is established, and it achieves the $\mathcal{O}(1/k)$ convergence rate with the appropriately selected step-size and parameters. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by an example on the demand response of energy systems.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Develops a distributed mirror descent algorithm with gradient extrapolation for Nash equilibrium seeking in multi-cluster aggregative games over time-varying graphs, using Bregman divergences to handle non-Euclidean settings.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对合作与竞争并存的多簇聚合博弈，论文提出带梯度外推的分布式镜像下降算法，在时变簇内与簇间网络上求解纳什均衡。采用Bregman散度代替欧氏距离，扩展了算法适用范围，并利用历史梯度信息加速收敛。该工作属于博弈论与分布式优化，为多智能体强化学习的策略更新与均衡分析提供可借鉴的分散化方法。
